paragraphs: Zunin told Rabbi Akiva, “My heart and yours know that idolatry has no substance.” Rashi explains that Zunin was an Israelite: Avodah Zarah 55a. Chiddushei Aggadot writes he may have been a gentile. There were two Zunins; each had a son named Boethus, and one was a priest (see his entry).
